verdict.rationale: An official on-device ML inference runtime is a fair question for a game engine, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows Bevy shipping or documenting any first-party ML or model-execution runtime. Its documented features cover ECS, rendering, animation, UI, scenes, audio and hot reload only, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a game developer, I can run ML models inside the game — an official inference runtime for on-device model execution
